task_name: Shared vocabulary/card response and batched hydration

concerns_addressed: Cycle-1 finding resolved: the integration fixture now compares every board card against an exact complete contract, including labels, status, priority, project/phase IDs, assignees, key, timestamps, and legacy metadata (server/src/routes/card-response.integration.test.ts:214-300).
Cycle-1 finding resolved: board label and assignee loader spies each assert one invocation with the complete seeded board card-ID set (server/src/routes/card-response.integration.test.ts:309-315).
The individual-card endpoint is checked against the same complete expected card contract and workspace compatibility (server/src/routes/card-response.integration.test.ts:317-322).

strengths: The shared vocabulary serializer preserves the base fields and conditionally emits category, slot, and createdAt; tracker item serialization and card serialization both consume it (server/src/routes/vocabulary-response.ts:12-21, server/src/routes/tracker-items.ts:89-108, server/src/routes/card-response.ts:96-98).

Board hydration performs one labels and one assignees loader call over all board card IDs, while each loader uses an IN predicate and groups results by card without row multiplication (server/src/routes/board.ts:106-111, server/src/routes/card-response.ts:107-144, server/src/routes/card-assignees.ts:23-46).

Board and card paths use the shared card mapper, and card responses do not import or resolve through the tracker router (server/src/routes/board.ts:43-48, server/src/routes/cards.ts:211-224, server/src/routes/card-response.ts:74-105).
The focused unit and integration commands pass: 2 vocabulary tests, 2 card-response tests, 8 board tests, and 1 integration test.
